alias_epoch: CitationTableGeneration is a distinct nominal type from RequestGeneration, session incarnation and execution-owner generation. Ordinary requests do not rotate the citation table.
scope: Citation integrity and compact reader only; existing admission policy is unchanged.
initial_representation: Exact retained Git blob bytes with half-open byte selectors; source/repository/path/revision/profile identity checked separately from content equality.
correspondence: Same immutable occurrence, context and evidence role is the only initial justified transport profile. Explicit material-field conclusions are independent of the executable identity predicate. Text search, even unique and exhaustive, is diagnostic only; other transformations and deletion without sufficient evidence remain unknown.
coverage: Unavailable enumeration is distinct from a measured exhaustive empty domain. Search coverage and presentation completeness remain separate.

citation-lean.meaning: Clean Lean build, complete registered axiom audit, executable examples, kernel-checked concrete mutant counterexamples and rejection at intended safety declarations. Mathematical fidelity is reviewed separately. Not full WF08 or a Rust refinement proof.

citation-verus.meaning: Actual domain/kernel body verification, frozen source and solver inventory, semantic mutations rejected at intended declarations, and independent evidence-admission controls. Not live-reader integration, complete V22, cross-prover refinement or full WF08.

production_obligations.V22: Actual selector, binding, alias, cursor, correspondence, coverage and reuse predicates, checked conversions and complete caller mapping.
production_obligations.native: Contained retained Git/blob acquisition, immutable storage, current authorization and real CLI/stdio entrypoints; storage-dependent integration requires P01O/WF24.
production_obligations.empirical: Complete repeated-workflow correctness and actual token/latency comparisons against competent targeted search plus kctx.

production_mapping.relation: Reviewed semantic correspondence and explicit caller boundaries, not a machine-checked Lean-to-Rust refinement theorem. Mathematical unbounded coordinates become checked u64 offsets and bounded usize scans in the Linux x86_64 profile.

CIT01.caller: compare and citation_reusable consume the actual resolver. Wire descriptor binding and native Git acquisition supply model material; the authenticated production host is not implemented.
CIT01.boundary: Reversed selectors refuse during typed construction; valid typed inputs still undergo access-first profile/unit/retained-length/preimage checks. Native capture and live authorization remain separate.

CIT02.caller: Library callers supply immutable bindings/query closure and current binding-specific model access. No CLI/stdio session restoration or capability negotiation is claimed.
CIT02.boundary: CitationTableGeneration is separate from RequestGeneration; exhausted allocation refuses. Prepared notice visibility/meaning and durable table restoration are host obligations.

CIT03.caller: Borrowed immutable representation vectors; not the durable retained-object store or publication/GC protocol.
CIT03.boundary: The Rust append operation cannot overwrite an existing key. Arbitrary operational retention histories still require the applicable native/protocol bridges.

CIT04.caller: compare consumes exact resolution and bounded text diagnosis; text candidates cannot construct UniqueJustified or a deletion judgment.
CIT04.boundary: Only identical immutable position/context/role transport is admitted. Native move/rename, provider selectors and unsupported coordinate transformations remain unknown.

CIT05.caller: citation_reusable invokes the actual legacy reusable predicate after exact ordered binding/context/access/retained-byte and observation-footprint checks.
CIT05.boundary: The added association never manufactures a receipt or bypasses legacy dependency, witness, correction, policy or time checks.

CIT06.caller: Borrowed KB/context/receipt inputs and unchanged legacy freshness implementation; no acquisition-hint writer is introduced.
CIT06.boundary: Inclusive expiry and independent surviving witnesses are exercised by component behavior cases. Live acquisition scheduling is not qualified here.

CIT08.caller: Pure borrowed core judgments and candidate byte codecs only; no new Witness/Derives constructor, knowledge writer or engineering transition caller.
CIT08.boundary: Full composed Rust state-transition erasure and operational noninterference remain unqualified until their real application/store callers exist.

gate_policy: No mixed-policy WF32/WF33 activation or renaming. A component receipt cannot close existing WF08, P05, P09, P11 or release. Full feature integration requires all relevant production, protocol and native obligations.
weft: External interpreter uses the same Writfold stdio interface as agents; no Weft-only opcodes, recipe VM or bypass.
